candidates.summary: the -max-realms cap silently drops changed realms, and the comment still links each one and claims none was dropped
candidates.failure_scenario: A PR that touches more than 25 realm directories (renderRelevant accepts gnomod.toml, and examples/gno.land/r holds 58 packages carrying one, so a tree-wide `gno = ...` bump or a `gno mod tidy` sweep does it) puts every one of them in plan.ChangedRealms at plan.go:229-243, before realms is truncated to maxRealms at plan.go:256-258. The truncated realms never reach plan.Dirs, gnodev or the crawler. Comment() then prints "**Changed realms (58)**" and, at comment.go:62-63, one bullet per changed realm with three links each (page, _t/source, _t/help) into the published preview; the 33 past the cap are 404s. comment.go:86 closes with "the changed realms are always kept", which is false in exactly this case. Measured with maxRealms=2 and 3 changed realms: Realms=[a b], ChangedRealms=[a b c], and the comment carries [`gno.land/r/x/c`](https://preview.example/pr-1/r/x/c/) plus the always-kept line.
candidates.verify_by: cp reviews/.../tests/b7-reach-plan-caps.go misc/gnopreview/zz_b7_reach_test.go && cd misc/gnopreview && go test -run TestB7CapDropsChangedRealms -v ./...
candidates.evidence: TestB7CapDropsChangedRealms FAIL: "ChangedRealms=[gno.land/r/x/a gno.land/r/x/b gno.land/r/x/c]", "Realms(rendered)=[gno.land/r/x/a gno.land/r/x/b] Dirs=[examples/gno.land/r/x/a examples/gno.land/r/x/b] Dropped=1", "comment links a realm that was never rendered: [`gno.land/r/x/c`](https://preview.example/pr-1/r/x/c/)", "comment claims every changed realm was kept, while [gno.land/r/x/c] were dropped". find examples/gno.land/r -name gnomod.toml | wc -l = 58, against defaultMaxRealms = 25 (main.go:29).

candidates.summary: Empty() calls a gnoweb plan with zero realms non-empty, and render() then indexes plan.Realms[0]
candidates.failure_scenario: gnowebSeedRealms (plan.go:46-51) is four hardcoded paths, and plan.go:273-274 adds one only when `pkgs[r] != nil`: a seed that is renamed or moved is dropped with no error, no log and no comment line, so a gnoweb preview quietly loses that sample page. At the extreme where no seed resolves, BuildPlan returns Gnoweb=true, Realms=[], and Empty() is false (plan.go:100 only checks Gnoweb and Realms), so render() passes the Empty() guard at main.go:111 and evaluates urlOf(plan.Realms[0]) at main.go:131: index out of range, a Go panic and a stack trace in place of the preview job, after gnodev has already been started with an empty dir list. The package's own plan_test.go case "gnoweb alone" pins this exact state (wantRealms: []string{}, wantMode: "gnoweb") and asserts Empty() is false. All four seeds exist at this head, so the panic needs seed drift; the silent drop needs one rename.
candidates.verify_by: cp reviews/.../tests/b7-reach-plan-caps.go misc/gnopreview/zz_b7_reach_test.go && cd misc/gnopreview && go test -run TestB7NonEmptyPlanWithNoRealms -v ./...
candidates.evidence: TestB7NonEmptyPlanWithNoRealms FAIL: "Gnoweb=true Realms=[] Empty=false Mode=\"gnoweb\"" then "render() panics on a non-empty plan with no realms: runtime error: index out of range [0] with length 0".

candidates.summary: seed realms are appended after the cap, so -max-realms is exceeded and the extra realms are crawled but never shown
candidates.failure_scenario: plan.go:272-279 appends up to four gnowebSeedRealms after the truncation at plan.go:256-258, so `-max-realms N` renders up to N+4 realms and plan.Dropped still reports the pre-seed count. In "both" mode (gnoweb plus a changed realm) render() takes the ChangedRealms branch at main.go:147, so Screenshot() never runs and comment.go:69 filters seeds out of the indirect list: the four seeds are loaded into gnodev, crawled against the shared MaxPages=400 budget with GnowebFileBudget pages each, and appear nowhere in the comment. Measured: -max-realms 2 with a gnoweb change and two changed realms rendered 3 realms.
candidates.verify_by: cp reviews/.../tests/b7-reach-plan-caps.go misc/gnopreview/zz_b7_reach_test.go && cd misc/gnopreview && go test -run TestB7SeedsOvershootCap -v ./...
candidates.evidence: TestB7SeedsOvershootCap FAIL: "max-realms=2 Realms=[gno.land/r/gnoland/home gno.land/r/x/a gno.land/r/x/b] (3) Dirs=3" and "-max-realms 2 rendered 3 realms".

candidates.summary: Pkg.Draft is parsed and never read
candidates.failure_scenario: modFlags returns both flags at plan.go:142 and only Ignore is consumed (plan.go:220, 241). Draft has no reader anywhere in the tree, so the field and half of modFlags are dead weight a later reader takes for a live filter. It is not a correctness bug: gnodev deploys the dirs through genesis, and the keeper rejects a draft package only above height 0 (gno.land/pkg/sdk/vm/keeper.go:668), so gno.land/r/demo/draftrealm previews fine.
candidates.verify_by: grep -rn '\.Draft\b' --include='*.go' . | grep gnopreview — one hit, the assignment at plan.go:142
candidates.evidence: grep over the worktree for `\.Draft\b` in *.go returns gnopreview only at plan.go:142; the other hits are gnolang/gotypecheck.go, sdk/vm/keeper.go, gnoweb/components/overview_build.go and github-bot.

dropped.summary: a draft realm in the plan makes gnodev refuse the package, so the readiness probe on Realms[0] times out for 5 minutes
dropped.settled_by: grep -rn 'Draft|draft' contribs/gnodev --include='*.go' returns nothing, and gno.land/pkg/sdk/vm/keeper.go:668 reads `if gm.Draft && height > 0 { return ErrInvalidPackage("draft packages can only be deployed at genesis time") }`: gnodev loads the dirs into genesis (height 0), so the one draft realm at head, gno.land/r/demo/draftrealm, deploys.
